description: This file defines a logging system in C++, including classes for logging, flushing logs, and managing log files, along with severity levels.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: Manages log file operations such as writing, opening, closing, and checking if logging is enabled.

classes.name: Flusher
classes.description: Handles buffering and flushing of log messages with different severity levels.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Provides an interface for logging messages with a specific component name and severity.

methods.name: LogFile::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LogFile.

methods.name: LogFile::write
methods.description: Writes a line to the log file.

methods.name: Flusher::operator<<
methods.description: Appends text to the log message buffer.

methods.name: Logger::operator<<
methods.description: Creates a Flusher object for logging with a specific severity.

methods.name: Logger::Logger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger with a component name.
